logic_rules.why: Glitched logic expects powerful glitches; no logic does not promise the seed can be finished.

damage_multiplier.why: Controls how much damage Link takes; ohko means one hit ends it.

item_pool_value.why: A scarcer item pool means fewer extra copies of major items.

junk_ice_traps.why: More ice traps mean more freezes at bad moments.

shuffle_bosses.why: Boss entrances are shuffled, so you can meet a boss without the usual setup.

shuffle_interior_entrances.why: Houses and other interiors lead somewhere else.

shuffle_overworld_entrances.why: The loading zones between areas are shuffled.

no_collectible_hearts.why: Hearts no longer drop from enemies or objects.

trials.why: Each required trial adds a challenge inside Ganon's Castle.

mq_dungeons_mode.why: Master Quest dungeon layouts are harder than the vanilla ones.

death_link.why: When any player dies, everyone dies.

accessibility.why: Minimal accessibility only promises the goal can be finished.
